title: Aft Cargo Compartment Wiring — Heating, Detection and Equipment Rack Feeds

ata.title: Aft Fuselage Wiring — Aft Cargo Wiring

abstract: Wiring diagram for the aft cargo compartment, covering the compartment heating loop, the smoke detection feeds and the equipment rack area behind the aft sidewall lining.

sections.purpose: This sheet gives the wiring of the aft cargo compartment, including the heating loop, the smoke detection feeds and the equipment rack area behind the aft sidewall lining.
sections.sheet_note: The sheet is drawn as a flattened development in the same convention as the forward compartment sheet. The heating loop connectors at the equipment rack are the ones that give trouble: they sit low on the rack and any water that runs down the rack face finds them. The drip loop shown on this sheet is the one that keeps the connector above the water line, and it is regularly refitted the wrong way up after a transmitter change, which puts the connector at the bottom of the loop instead of the top.
sections.routing_note: The compartment feeds enter at the aft pressure bulkhead penetration, run forward along the sidewall at the equipment rack line and branch at each heating loop position. The smoke detection feeds run above the heating loop with the separation given in the notes, and the equipment rack area feeds drop vertically behind the rack face.
